title: Gregorian age at least
description: True when age on reference_date is at least min_age.
rule: Let age = reference_year - birth_year minus 1 when (reference month,day) is before (birth month,day). For Feb 29 birthdays in a non-leap reference year, treat the birthday as March 1 for the month-day comparison. If birthdate is after reference_date, the predicate is false for every min_age including 0. Otherwise the predicate is true when age >= min_age.
